name: net_restarted_game_rejoins_while_loading
description: Two seats; client 1 is slow to load, so the match still loads when client 2's game, which has loaded and notes its seat (as a --join game does), is killed and started again. Its first HELLO is a resume naming the seat; the sequencer, as the server does, takes the seat back while the match loads and sends MATCH_CONFIG as at the start (no rejoin flag), and the game loads again like any seat: LOADED, START once client 1 has loaded too, and the match plays with both seats, its overlay showing nothing, its orders going out, and the hashes agreeing.

steps.msg: client 2 has loaded and noted its seat; client 1 still loads
started again, its first HELLO asks the seat back

steps.assert: reloaded and not scene.client(2).boot_resume and scene.seq.rejoins == 1 and scene.seq.no_held_seat == 0
steps.msg: the seat was taken back while the match loads: a plain MATCH_CONFIG, and it loaded again as any seat
the match still waits for client 1
it plays its seat: no overlay, its orders go out
the seat never went AWAY: it was loaded when the match started
every hash agrees, and nothing was refused
